implementation_scope: Lineage/audit requirements only — NO transformation engine in 3I.1 or initial 3I.2
principle: PropositionRecords evolve via evidence-triggered scientific transformations, NOT a fixed progression catalog.

SUPPORT.trigger: Experiment result aligns with falsifiable_expectation within declared tolerance
SUPPORT.creates: Lineage edge with evidence hash — same proposition_id, updated epistemic status

WEAKEN.trigger: Result directionally consistent but magnitude below threshold or high variance

FALSIFY.trigger: Result crosses disconfirming threshold or matches null_competing_explanation better

NARROW.trigger: Effect concentrated in sub-population discovered post-hoc from evidence
NARROW.requires: New population_context must cite evidence slice — not template default

BROADEN.trigger: Effect generalizes beyond original population with evidence

CHANGE_POPULATION.trigger: Original population unsupported; evidence points to different definable population
CHANGE_POPULATION.requires: Falsify or weaken prior population + new grounding

CHANGE_OUTCOME.trigger: Original outcome uninformative; alternative outcome shows signal in evidence
CHANGE_OUTCOME.requires: Outcome change motivated by experiment diagnostics

CHANGE_HORIZON.requires: Horizon sweep or temporal evidence — not planner preference

SEEK_COUNTEREXAMPLE.trigger: Partial support — active search for disconfirming slice

ABANDON.trigger: Falsified, exhausted budget, or superseded by stronger fork

FORK_NEW_EXPLANATION.trigger: Evidence rejects core relation but supports alternative mechanism
FORK_NEW_EXPLANATION.requires: New proposition_id with parent_id link + new birth certificate for fork

examples: Auto-advance to next template in family
GAP code change without new observation

lineage_record_schema.prior_state_snapshot: hash of proposition fields before transition

audit_requirements.immutability: Prior PropositionRecord versions preserved — append-only lineage graph
audit_requirements.evidence_first: No transition without experiment_id or observation update ref
audit_requirements.no_hidden_catalog: Transitions not chosen from enumerated menu in code — classifier determines transition from evidence rules
audit_requirements.fork_rules: FORK_NEW_EXPLANATION requires fresh birth certificate and new template_independence audit

connection_to_existing_systems.experiment_results: research portfolio / experiment completion hooks — read-only integration point for 3I.2+
connection_to_existing_systems.planner: Must NOT drive lineage transitions in OPR layer
connection_to_existing_systems.challenger: Future: FALSIFY/SEEK_COUNTEREXAMPLE may receive challenger proposals — not integrated now
